title: The Illegal trade in the port
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：illegal　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 illegal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the keeper wrote of ① an illegal trade in the port in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② so illegal that nobody in the tower would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the illegal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the illegal trade in the port that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1960 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too illegal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the illegal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an illegal copy of the program, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as illegal as the copy of the program they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was illegal or not, and he said so.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something illegal, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite illegal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the illegal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976, in public, she wrote of another illegal trade in the port in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less illegal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The illegal copy of the program that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1978, was the one she could never quite name; the illegal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 非法（前置定语 an illegal trade in the port：1966 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件非法的买卖）
B. adj. 非法／违规（两处加强说法：so illegal that … 与 no less illegal than …）
C. adj. 非法／违规（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 非法（表语 too illegal to do：母亲觉得它太非法，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 违规（前置定语 an illegal copy of the program：叔叔把整件事称作一桩违规的非授权副本）
F. adj. 违规（同级比较 as illegal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩程序的非授权副本相比）
G. adj. 违规（后置定语 something illegal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 违规（受程度副词修饰 quite illegal：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: an illegal trade in the port
the illegal trade in the port that
an illegal copy of the program
The illegal copy of the program that

answers.why: illegal 意为“非法”，1966 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件非法的买卖”，此处作前置定语 an illegal trade in the port。
illegal 意为“非法”，此处用 so illegal that 结构，说它非法到钟楼里没人敢靠近。
illegal 意为“非法”，年历上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的非法港口的非法买卖，等于最高级的说法。
illegal 意为“非法”，母亲认为这件东西“太非法了，谁也用不上”，too illegal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
illegal 意为“违规”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩违规的非授权副本”，此处作前置定语 an illegal copy of the program。
illegal 意为“违规”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩程序的非授权副本一样违规”，同级比较用 as illegal as。
illegal 意为“违规”，年历上那半行字要的是“违规的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something illegal。
illegal 意为“违规”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当违规”，quite 修饰原级 illegal。
illegal 意为“违规”，no less illegal than 表示“其违规不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之违规不亚于任何人的预料。
illegal 意为“违规”，母亲 1978 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的违规非授权副本”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件非法的买卖。（an illegal trade in the port）
它非法到钟楼里没有一个人敢靠近。（so illegal that …）
母亲觉得它太非法，谁也用不上。（too illegal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩违规的非授权副本。（an illegal copy of the program）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩程序的非授权副本一样违规。（as illegal as …）
到了 1973 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件违规的东西。（something illegal）
answers: In 1966 the keeper wrote of an illegal trade in the port in the calendar.
It was so illegal that nobody in the tower would go near it.
My mother thought it too illegal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an illegal copy of the program.
He said nobody would call it as illegal as the copy of the program they had once had.
By 1973 the calendar asked for nothing but something illegal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 illegal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the keeper wrote of an illegal trade in the port in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the illegal trade in the port that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too illegal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an illegal copy of the program, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite illegal, and everybody laughed.
The illegal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
